# COMPLIANCE

The compliance matrix of the Prism runtimes: one row per feature of `@prism-code/conformance`, one column per runtime.
A cell is `+` when every scenario of the feature passed on that runtime in the run that generated this file, `-` when any scenario failed, errored or is an expected failure, or the runtime has no report yet, and `N/A` when the runtime declares the feature not applicable, with its reason below.
Every scenario cites the ids of `CONFORMANCE.md`. Design: `docs/proposals/287-conformance.md`.

| `inspect` | + | - | - |

## Features

| Feature | What it covers | Defined by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `load` | Open a .holo archive and verify its footer, every content-blob label and the manifest cross-references | `HO-20`, `docs/proposals/263-spec-package.md` |
| `inspect` | Describe an archive without running it: sections, dual digests, manifest, model and provenance, as prismpm/holo-inspection/1 | `HO-20`, `docs/proposals/271-inspect.md` |
| `vectors` | Dispatch every acceptance vector the model carries through the Core-Wasm guest and compare byte for byte | `HO-20` |
| `history` | Write the acceptance vectors as a prism/history/1 history | `HO-29`, `docs/proposals/284-histories-replay.md` |
| `replay` | Re-execute recorded histories against a build, report every divergence and write the prism/replay/v1 statement, with exit codes 0, 1 and 2 | `HO-29`, `docs/proposals/284-histories-replay.md` |
| `check` | Judge an archive against a policy and return a prism/verdict/1 with its assurance level, with exit codes 0, 1 and 2 | `docs/proposals/269-assurance-levels.md`, `docs/proposals/270-check-rust.md` |
| `world` | Report the WIT world the archive declares and whether the guest conforms, and judge the pure-world and pinned-contract policies | `docs/proposals/278-wit-world.md`, `docs/proposals/283-world-within-policy.md` |
| `attestations` | Report the attestation section: absent in an archive of revision 2026-10-23, listed when present, and withholding a verdict until a revision admits it | `docs/proposals/267-attestation-bundle.md`, `docs/proposals/271-inspect.md` |
